patch.value: GH-676: list tag filter must accept the CSV shape used by tag mutations

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/676 reports that pm list --tag with comma-separated tags silently returns no items even though mutation commands accept CSV tags. Normalize list filtering and emit unknown-tag diagnostics.
